suggestions.title: Increase Instagram posting frequency and optimize posting times
suggestions.problem: Instagram reach is critically low (2 today), indicating minimal audience exposure and potential posting inactivity or poor timing
suggestions.root_cause: Chirumaru likely posts infrequently or at suboptimal times when the target audience (bakery/cafe enthusiasts) is less active. Japanese users typically engage most during morning commute (7-9 AM) and evening leisure time (7-10 PM)
suggestions.suggestion: Establish a consistent posting schedule of 4-5 times per week, with posts scheduled for 8 AM and 7 PM JST. Focus on carousel posts featuring bakery/cafe discoveries with location tags and user-generated content to boost algorithmic reach
suggestions.expected_impact: Increase daily Instagram reach from 2 to 50-100 by improving visibility during peak engagement windows; this could drive 15-25% additional website traffic
suggestions.implementation_note: Create a content calendar using Instagram's scheduling feature. Example post structure: [Image 1: Bakery exterior] → [Image 2: Featured pastry close-up] → [Image 3: Cafe interior] with caption template: '【新発見】[店名] - [特徴3つ] #カフェ好きさんと繋がりたい #パン屋さん #[地域]'

suggestions.title: Reduce session drop-off and improve content engagement on website
suggestions.problem: Website shows declining engagement: engaged_sessions represent only 44-56% of total sessions, and recent days (Aug 20-21) show sharp drops in sessions (9→2) with zero engaged sessions on Aug 21
suggestions.root_cause: Users visiting the site are not finding compelling content to interact with. Possible causes: unclear navigation, lack of filtering options for bakery/cafe search, slow page load times, or insufficient bakery listing information (hours, menus, reviews)
suggestions.suggestion: Implement a prominent search/filter widget on the homepage allowing users to filter by: (1) bakery type (croissants, sourdough, wagashi, etc.), (2) location/prefecture, (3) rating/reviews. Add rich snippets showing bakery photos, operating hours, and average rating on listing cards to encourage clicks
suggestions.expected_impact: Increase engaged_sessions ratio from 44-56% to 65-75%; reduce bounce rate by 20%; improve average session duration by 40-60 seconds

suggestions.title: Re-engage users through email/push notifications after Instagram posts
suggestions.problem: Instagram reach (2) and website traffic are disconnected; there's no visible funnel converting Instagram awareness into website visits. Weekend traffic collapsed (Aug 16-17, Aug 21)
suggestions.root_cause: Users who see Instagram posts may not remember to visit the website later, especially during low-engagement periods. Instagram algorithm may not surface Chirumaru content to users who don't actively follow the account. Weekend dips suggest lack of weekend-specific content or retargeting
suggestions.suggestion: Create an Instagram-to-website retargeting workflow: (1) Add 'Link in Bio' CTA with specific landing page (e.g., '今週のイチオシ' featured bakery), (2) Implement push notifications on website for users who visited but didn't engage, (3) Post weekend-specific content Friday evening (e.g., 'Weekend Cafe Guide') to capture leisure browsing
suggestions.expected_impact: Convert 10-15% of Instagram viewers to website visitors; increase weekend sessions by 30-50%; boost repeat visit rate (returning users) by 25%
suggestions.implementation_note: Example push notification: {'title': '新しいパン屋が登録されました', 'body': '〇〇県で見つけた最高のクロワッサン', 'icon': '[bakery_image]', 'badge': 'NEW'}. Implement with Firebase Cloud Messaging or Web Push API, targeting users who bounced after <30 seconds
